title: Theriva™ Biologics Announces Halt of Common Stock Trading

body_markdown:
November 23, 2026 16:30 ET


ROCKVILLE, Md., Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Theriva™ Biologics, Inc. (NYSE American: TOVX), a diversified clinical-stage company developing therapeutics designed to treat cancer and related diseases in areas of high unmet need, announced today that trading of its shares of common stock has been halted by the NYSE American LLC (“NYSE American”) due to the low trading price of the Company’s shares of common stock for a substantial period of time and the fact that its common stock traded below $0.10 on November 23, 2026. The Company expects the halt in trading to continue until the Company effectuates the 1-for-30 reverse stock split of its common stock that it announced on November 20, 2026 (the “Reverse Split”).


The Company anticipates that the Reverse Stock Split will be effective at 11:59 p.m., Eastern Time, on December 1, 2026 (the “Effective Time”), and that, subject to NYSE American approval, the Company’s common stock will begin trading on the NYSE American on a split-adjusted basis when the market opens on December 2, 2026. Although not anticipated by the Company, the NYSE American could suspend trading and move to delist the Company’s common stock if the price per share post-split does not meet the requirements of Section 1003(f)(v) of the NYSE American Company Guide.


**About Theriva™ Biologics, Inc.**


Theriva™ Biologics (NYSE American: TOVX) is a diversified clinical-stage company developing therapeutics designed to treat cancer and related diseases in areas of high unmet need. The Company’s subsidiary Theriva Biologics, S.L., has been developing a new oncolytic adenovirus platform designed for intravenous (IV), intravitreal and intratumoral delivery to trigger tumor cell death, improve access of co-administered cancer therapies to the tumor, and promote a robust and sustained anti-tumor response by the patient’s immune system. The Company’s lead clinical-stage candidate is VCN-01 (zabilugene almadenorepvec), an oncolytic adenovirus designed to replicate selectively within tumor cells, and to degrade the tumor stroma barrier that serves as a significant physical and immunosuppressive barrier to cancer treatment. For more information, please visit Theriva™ Biologics’ website at www.therivabio.com.
